entities.name: Tyranids
entities.description: Space-faring ecosystem of bioforms united by a psychic hivemind that treats all life as prey.

entities.name: Genestealers
entities.description: Tyranid organisms that infiltrate worlds and seed hybrid bloodlines.

entities.name: Genestealer Cults
entities.description: Hybrid organizations that foment rebellion to prepare worlds for the Hive Fleets.

entities.name: Tyranid Hive Fleets
entities.description: Tyranid fleets whose coming Genestealer Cults prepare for.

events.summary: Genestealer Cults foment rebellion on host worlds to prepare for the Hive Fleets.
events.quote: These mutants organize themselves into organizations known as Genestealer Cults that foment rebellion upon their host worlds

relations.quote: Certain Tyranid organisms known as Genestealers have been known to infiltrate settled worlds
